description: Normalised AZYRON CLIENT download events. This is the shape the website reads to build its shared counters. It is produced from GitHub's own download record (the release assets' download_count) so that every number shown on the site corresponds to a download GitHub actually recorded. When a first-party event stream (edge function, analytics worker) exists, it can write the same shape and the site needs no changes.
note: Empty on purpose. The site derives live figures from GitHub's authoritative download_count minus the launch baseline. Per-event rows require a first-party counter; see scripts/event-store.mjs.
